title: Preserve engineering meaning across architecture views
statement: The system shall present the five architecture views and their selected details as attributable projections of the selected model, preserving ownership, relationship meaning, qualification and completeness limits.

what.problem: A view may misrepresent facts or hide incomplete interpretation.
what.desired_outcome: present the five architecture views and their selected details as attributable projections of the selected model, preserving ownership, relationship meaning, qualification and completeness limits.

why.rationale: Customer use needs attributable, portable views and truthful boundaries beyond repository-local demonstration.

conditions: When generating, reading or qualifying the selected architecture browser capability.

contexts: One selected customer project/state and explicitly selected output; declared product generation and reading environments.

how.approach: Assess the stated observable outcomes against explicit supported profiles, selected source identity and actual artifacts; preserve ownership and diagnose unavailable or incomplete results.

how_much.scope: Read-only local generation and portable snapshot reading. No live editor, hosted-service requirement, cross-project aggregation, automatic publication or invented performance target. Detailed realization and platform support are downstream design decisions.

acceptance_criteria: Readers can navigate each available view from an overview to relevant definitions, relationships and applicable rationale, using readable labels and keyboard-accessible navigation.
Logical ownership and containment remain distinct from execution and deployment; a shared source file does not merge logical responsibilities.
Process topology does not imply execution order or concurrency. Selected activity, interaction and lifecycle details appear only where authoritative semantics establish them.
Proposed and observed facts remain distinguishable in overviews and details, even when names are identical; each detail exposes its selected-state source basis.
Scenario navigation retains stakeholder meaning and identified architecture participation without turning reachability or rendering into coverage, approval or satisfaction.
Missing required explanation and incomplete selections remain explicit; absent details are not fabricated and view success does not establish a complete design.

sources.basis: User-requested reusable customer architecture browser; requirement-level author analysis. Current records remain draft; no implemented, published or independently approved behavior is claimed.

System and Architecture Design from SR-084–088 and refined SR-060; proposed responsibility, contract and realization only. No implementation, platform qualification or product availability is established.
